datasheet_identity.title: ES2A THRU ES2J SURFACE MOUNT FAST RECOVERY RECTIFIER

curves.name: Typical forward voltage, ES2J
curves.test_conditions: Tj=25 °C; pulse width=300 μs; 1% duty cycle

extraction_notes: Identity confirmed: ES2J is listed as the device marking code and electrical-characteristics column in the ES2A THRU ES2J datasheet; the footer identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd., Rev:1.1.

Maximum DC blocking voltage for ES2J is 600 V at Ta=25 °C unless otherwise specified (PDF p. 1). It is retained as observed DC evidence but is not mapped to breakdown_voltage because the datasheet labels it VDC, not breakdown voltage.

Maximum DC reverse current is 5 μA at VR=VDC, TA=25 °C and 100 μA at VR=VDC, TA=125 °C (PDF p. 2). The schema permits one reverse-current object, so the 25 °C row is structured and the 125 °C maximum is retained here.
Curve points are direct readings of the labeled ES2J dotted trace at major decade gridlines in Fig. 3; no interpolation was used.
DC-only scope omitted reverse-recovery time, junction capacitance, RMS-voltage, surge-current, and thermal evidence. No breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current rating was identified.
extraction.omission_reason: DC-only extraction. The datasheet provides no explicitly labeled breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification, and non-DC, surge, and thermal characteristics were omitted by scope.

current.conditions: Conservative F1 package bench at 95% of the cited current; IF=2.0 A
